digest_items.title: 30 名工程师、一个宏大愿景，却没有真实需求：谷歌高管反思产品开发狂热
digest_items.content: 当 AI 模型每隔几个月就更新一轮，昨天还做不到的事情，今天可能已经能用一段提示词实现，产品团队该怎样规划未来？是紧盯模型榜单，追逐每一次能力升级，还是尽快做出原型，看看用户是否愿意留下来？更棘手的是，当做产品越来越容易，团队又该凭什么判断，哪些值得继续投入，哪些应该及时放弃？ 在这期 Lenny’s Podcast 中，谷歌 17 年老兵，负责 Google Labs、Gemini 应用和 AI Studio 的 Josh Woodward，分享了他对这些问题的观察。他的工作横跨两个差异很大的场景：一边是尚未证明需求、从零起步的实验项目，另一边是面向大规模用户的 AI 产品。如何发现机会、组织实验，再把探索变成用户真正需要的东西，是贯穿这场对话的主线。 主持人 Lenny 提出了一个判断：每家公司都需要开始像实验室一样思考和运作。Josh 对此表示认同，但他强调，成立一支追踪前沿技术的团队只是开始。公司还必须给这些人动手探索的空间，并有能力识别，那些眼下看似玩具的东西，是否可能成为未来的重要业务。 对于好点子从哪里来，Josh 表示并不来自头脑风暴或设计冲刺。在他的经验里，很多想法来自一小群充满好奇、忍不住动手尝试的人。团队的准备工作，则包括维护一份“几乎可以实现”的清单：持续观察技术边界，一旦某件事跨过可行的门槛，就迅速组织探索。他透露，团队曾写下 82 条关于未来的预测，明知其中大部分可能出错，仍然需要形成自己的判断。 但技术上的惊艳，并不意味着产品就能成功。Josh 回忆了第一次听到 NotebookLM 播客的场景，也谈到另一面：有些演示让团队兴奋不已，真正做成产品后却并不好用。展示早期原型时，他关注的是用户的眼睛是否发亮、是否不由自主地靠近。他也提醒团队，要执着于解决的问题，因为具体方案可能需要经过多次调整。 这场对话同样花了不少时间讨论“什么时候停下来”。Josh 认为，团队通常比领导更早知道一个项目行不通。负责人需要让大家敢于说出坏消息，甚至在发布前主动叫停一个不够好的功能。与之相伴的，是对过早扩张的警惕：团队人数翻倍，并不能证明产品找到了市场。 AI 也在改变他对人才和组织的判断。过去需要五到七人的探索团队，如今可能只需两到三人。他看重的能力包括放下旧认知的速度、能够持续投入的爆发力，以及快速建立信任的能力。但他不认同所有岗位都会融合成一种通用的“构建者”：会写代码、做原型，应当帮助产品经理深化专业能力，而不是让专业本身失去价值。 从六个月滚动规划、五十到一百天的项目里程碑，到冲刺与自由探索交替的工作节奏，Josh 给出了不少具体做法。他也直言，模型基准测试被过度关注，而产品背后的原则与价值观讨论得还不够。 对话最终回到了一个更根本的问题：当 AI 让越来越多的产品变得可造，我们究竟希望造出什么？未来是成千上万个独立应用，还是少数统一入口承载的个性化体验？Josh 没有给出确定答案。对他而言，持续探索的前提，是既敢于对未来下注，也愿意在证据改变时，放下自己原来的判断。 以下为访谈实录： Lenny：我们就从寻找好点子开始。回顾 Google Labs，甚至整个谷歌诞生过的优秀创意，你观察到哪些规律？最好的点子通常来自哪里？ Josh Woodward：我也希望这件事能有一个标准答案，但实际上，好点子的来源非常多样。我一直以来的一个体会是，你必须随时留意那些能吸引你注意的东西。 至少在我的经验中，好点子很少来自设计冲刺，也很少诞生于日历上专门划出的某个时段——比如，“接下来这段时间，我们要想出下一个好创意”。 它们往往出现在走廊里的交流中、周末，或者假期。我们不少实验室团队的人会忍不住动手折腾、做点东西。回来后，他们会拿出成果，或者分享一段视频，说：“快看，这个东西太棒了。” 所以，第一点是始终保持敏锐。第二点是，好点子通常不会出现在那些按部就班安排好的场合。你不能把好点子放进微波炉里，指望它马上就熟了。 第三点是，有时候与其盯着想法本身，不如关注那些有意思的人。更重要的是，他们正在做哪些有趣的个人项目，真正热衷于什么，以及如何让这些人和兴趣碰撞出火花。 回顾过去四五年，无论是 Notebook、Flow、AI Studio，还是 Google Beam，很多项目最初都来自一小群人。他们对某件事充满好奇，甚至到了痴迷的程度，根本停不下来。 我们要做的，就是创造一个允许这种探索发生的空间，同时保持敏锐：当这样的想法出现时，能够发现它，再帮助它向前发展。 Lenny：所以，有意思的是，你没有提到设计冲刺，也没有把头脑风暴会议列为好点子的主要来源。那么，对于正在尝试最新模型的创业者，或者大公司的员工，什么样的条件最有助于发现好点子？ Josh digest_items.title: [生活] 假如我不曾结婚成家生娃
digest_items.content: 凡事都有两面性，有得必有失，借着 500ML 的喜力下肚，写写自己最近的心境吧。 假如我不曾结婚，我可以一下班就玩 GTA5 ，在洛圣都随时切换 3 种人生，手痒了就开车出去南大干线劈弯放空大脑，周末就去爬那些没什么景色的小山丘，想做什么就做什么。 但是我已经结婚了，还生了个可爱的女儿，虽然我还想给她生个伴，但是老婆一直很抗拒再生。 又由于时运不济，工作了十来年，一直没进过大厂，最多是个中小厂，其余时间都在所谓的创业公司、创业团队。 最近这一份工作即将结束，合同不再续签，由于提早两个月就知道了，所以最近一两个月心情都很沮丧。 上周，我对我老婆说，马上就要离职了，我做好了半年找到下一份工作的准备。她回了一句：我不同意。 我没有激烈反对她，淡淡回了一句：不是你一句不同意就能马上找到工作的。 想起中秋吃团圆饭的时候，全家人包括大姐一家也在，说起最近很多名牌大学生重新高考报读医学院的事，在医院上班的老姐说也认识一个这样的人啥都干过现在三十多了拜师学中医去了，大家都对这种做法表示同意和赞赏。 唯独一个人当着所有人的面说了一句：我不同意，我不同意他回炉再造！ 这个人就是我老婆，想想我这也是挺悲哀的，我也没说我要回炉重造，毕竟，能做出这样的决定，那心里建设得多强啊？ 但身为男人，假如枕边人对你的心境完全不了解，只会站在站在自己角度，做出最符合自己利益或者小家庭利益的决定，两次“不同意”，作为男人，真的很伤心，这婚姻有什么意义？文学作品里的所谓的相濡以沫真的存在吗？所以的执子之手白头偕老，在二十世纪三十年代，它还存在吗？借着这喜力的熏陶，稍微绷不住我都要哭出来了。 曾经的我坚信，生而为人，就有义务生养后代，为人类族群生生不息。 但后来年纪大了，上一次失业的时候去了趟河西走廊，开了一点天眼，后来才知道那个叫总观效应。再到后来，开始看修仙短剧，动辄上千上万年的修仙，又让我对人生彻底改观了，纵使再努力，纵使再不堪，也不过百年寿元，又何必事事执着呢？ 当然，假如我至今未婚，可能又是另一幅景象了，每天就忙着流连于各大社交平台找对象吧？ 世间安得双全法，不负如来不负卿。 诸君，你们觉得呢？

digest_items.title: [推广] I built Bulin 47 AI — put yourself in the viral Bulin 47 freestyle from one photo (720P, original sound, $9.99, no subsc
digest_items.content: Hi V2EX, If you have scrolled TikTok or Reels this October, you have probably seen the Bulin 47 freestyle : Dominican dembow artist Bulin 47 gets stopped outside a venue in Madrid by creator Kevin Wai, who holds up a portable speaker, and he drops an improvised freestyle on the spot. Within days people started remixing it with AI — same scene, same crowd, same beat, but a different person in the lead. I built a small web tool for exactly that: Bulin 47 AI — https://bulin47ai-video.com Upload one photo → get the original Bulin 47 freestyle with you as the lead performer. No prompt, no editing, no app. How it works Upload one clear, front-facing photo (waist-up works best). Pick a format: 9:16 for TikTok / Reels / Shorts, 1:1 for feeds, or 16:9 for YouTube. Sign in with Google, press generate, and download an MP4 a few minutes later. Under the hood it uses a video-edit model with the original clip as the reference, so the venue, the red-lit staircase, the speaker holder, the crowd reactions, the camera moves and the beat all stay the same — only the performer is swapped for the person in your photo. What I tried to do better than the other Bulin 47 sites I looked at most of the Bulin 47 generators that popped up this month before building this. These are the things that bugged me as a user, and what I did instead: 1. 720P HD by default — not a 480P upsell Every video is 720P HD, 15 seconds, with the original sound. There is no cheap low-res tier that you only discover after paying. Faces and hand gestures hold up noticeably better at 720P, which matters for a clip where the whole point is that your friends recognise you. 2. Honest per-video pricing 1 video: $9.99 3 videos: $24.99 ($8.33 each) 10 videos: $69.99 ($7.00 each) One credit = one full 15-second 720P video. Imagine this: Most websites you visit get paid to show ads and indirectly run my script that lets me know you’re the … . I can use it to decide what ads you’ll see. But more importantly, if you’ve made an account on that website, I can offer to buy your data - whatever they can share under their privacy policy: your name, activity, conversations with AI… Pretty soon I’d know more about you than your friends do - perhaps more than you know yourself. “So what?” - you say. “I have nothing to hide. And I prefer my ads to be relevant… sometimes they show me exactly what I need! And the data is anonymised anyway…” See, the thing is, it’s not about you at all. It’s not really about the ads anymore either. Nobody cares about you. And if the police or your government happen to care, I’ll gladly take their money too. I look at all this data and I don’t see people. I see patterns. Patterns emerging out of patterns. A living, digital fractal state of the economy, society and human psyche. digest_items.summary_en: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.

digest_items.title: xtool-org/xtool
digest_items.description: Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, macOS.
digest_items.readme:
# xtool

Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

## Overview

xtool is a cross-platform (Linux/WSL/macOS) tool that replicates Xcode functionality with open standards.

✅ Build a SwiftPM package into an iOS app

✅ Sign and install iOS apps

✅ Interact with Apple Developer Services programmatically

## Getting Started

1. Follow the guide to install `xtool`
    - [Installation (Linux/Windows)](https://xtool.sh/documentation/xtooldocs/installation-linux)
    - [Installation (macOS)](https://xtool.sh/documentation/xtooldocs/installation-macos)
2. Create and run your first xtool-powered app by following the [tutorial](https://xtool.sh/tutorials/xtooldocs/first-app)!

## Examples

### Screenshot

![A screenshot of xtool being invoked from VSCode](Documentation/xtool.docc/Resources/Cover.png)

### Command line interface

```bash
$ xtool --help
OVERVIEW: Cross-platform Xcode replacement

USAGE: xtool <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help              Show help information.

CONFIGURATION SUBCOMMANDS:
  setup                   Set up xtool for iOS development
  auth                    Manage Apple Developer Services authentication
  sdk                     Manage the Darwin Swift SDK

DEVELOPMENT SUBCOMMANDS:
  new                     Create a new xtool SwiftPM project
  dev                     Build and run an xtool SwiftPM project
  ds                      Interact with Apple Developer Services

DEVICE SUBCOMMANDS:
  devices                 List devices
  install                 Install an ipa file to your device
  uninstall               Uninstall an installed app
  launch                  Launch an installed app

  See 'xtool help <subcommand>' for detailed help.
```

### Library

xtool includes a library that you can use to interact with Apple Developer Services, iOS devices, and more from your own app. You can use this by adding `XKit` as a SwiftPM dependency.

```swift
// package dependency:
.package(url:
digest_items.author: xtool-org
digest_items.summary_zh: xtool-org/xtool 是一个跨平台 Xcode 替代品，能借助 SwiftPM 在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上构建并部署 iOS 应用，还可签名安装 App、以编程方式调用 Apple Developer Services。它用开放标准复刻 Xcode 的核心能力，适合想在非 Mac 环境或 CI 里完成 iOS 构建的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: xtool-org/xtool is a cross-platform replacement for Xcode: it builds a SwiftPM package into an iOS app, signs and installs it, and talks to Apple Developer Services programmatically from Linux, Windows, WSL or macOS. Aimed at developers who want iOS builds outside a Mac, or in CI, without depending on Xcode itself.

digest_items.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
digest_items.readme: # Ghidra Software Reverse Engineering Framework Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the [National Security Agency][nsa] Research Directorate. This framework includes a suite of full-featured, high-end software analysis tools that enable users to analyze compiled code on a variety of platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux. Capabilities include disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting, along with hundreds of other features. Ghidra supports a wide variety of processor instruction sets and executable formats and can be run in both user-interactive and automated modes. Users may also develop their own Ghidra extension components and/or scripts using Java or Python. In support of NSA's Cybersecurity mission, Ghidra was built to solve scaling and teaming problems on complex SRE efforts, and to provide a customizable and extensible SRE research platform. NSA has applied Ghidra SRE capabilities to a variety of problems that involve analyzing malicious code and generating deep insights for SRE analysts who seek a better understanding of potential vulnerabilities in networks and systems. If you are a U.S. citizen interested in projects like this, to develop Ghidra and other cybersecurity tools for NSA to help protect our nation and its allies, consider applying for a [career with us][career]. ## Security Warning **WARNING:** There are known security vulnerabilities within certain versions of Ghidra. Before proceeding, please read through Ghidra's [Security Advisories][security] for a better understanding of how you might be impacted. ## Install To install an official pre-built multi-platform Ghidra release: * Install [JDK 25 64-bit][jdk] * Download a Ghidra [release file][releases] - **NOTE:** The official multi-platform release file is named `ghidra___.zip` which can

digest_items.summary_en: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering framework built and maintained by the National Security Agency's Research Directorate. It bundles disassembly, decompilation, graphing and scripting for Windows, macOS and Linux binaries across many processor instruction sets, and runs both interactively and in automated mode. Users can extend it with Java or Python, making it a customizable platform for malware analysis and large-team SRE work.

digest_items.title: ntdevlabs/tiny11builder
digest_items.description: WinUI app for building smaller, customized Windows 11 images.
digest_items.readme:
# Tiny11 Builder

Build a smaller Windows 11 ISO with a native WinUI app. Download an official
Windows image or use your own, choose what to remove, and create your ISO.

## Download

[**Get the latest version**](https://github.com/ntdevlabs/tiny11builder/releases/latest)

Choose **x64** for Intel/AMD PCs or **ARM64** for Windows on ARM. Extract the
entire ZIP and open `Tiny11Builder.exe`. Administrator approval is required.

## Choose your build

| Mode | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Tiny11 | Removes bundled apps and unwanted features while keeping updates, Defender and recovery. |
| Tiny11 Core | Trims further by removing servicing and recovery support and disabling Defender. |
| Custom | Choose individual apps, components, features and services to remove or keep. |

Turbo mode speeds up image processing. Interrupted builds can resume from saved
progress after the image is committed or compressed. Core and component-store
removals automatically use the legacy Windows installer.

**Core cannot be updated or serviced. Protected Custom removals can break
Windows. Test your ISO in a VM before installing it.**

## Video

[**Watch on YouTube**](https://youtu.be/LfEWIz5mQ8A)

## Screenshots

### Welcome

![Tiny11 Builder welcome screen with Tiny11, Tiny11 Core and Custom modes](docs/images/ui-welcome.png)

### Components

![Component choices and the Tiny11 Core warning](docs/images/ui-components.png)

### Build settings

![Build settings with Turbo mode and optional image cleanup](docs/images/ui-build-settings.png)

## More information

[Usage, compatibility and build instructions](docs/usage.md) ·
[Attribution and distribution notes](NOTICE.md)

The original PowerShell builders remain in this repository.

digest_items.summary_en: Tiny11 Builder is a native WinUI app that turns an official or user-supplied Windows image into a smaller, customized Windows 11 ISO. It offers three build modes, Tiny11 (keeps updates, Defender and recovery), Tiny11 Core (drops servicing and recovery, disables Defender) and Custom (pick components individually), plus a Turbo mode to speed up processing. Core images can't be updated or serviced and protected Custom removals can break Windows, so testing the ISO in a VM first is advised.
